verdict.rationale: The only calendar-related evidence is a passing mention that AgentMail's hosted MCP server exposes generic 'calendar tools.' Nothing documents sharing availability or inserting bookable meeting times into an email, so this is at most an adjacent feature and earns no credit. The axis does apply: an email platform could plausibly offer scheduling or availability insertion, so the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my availability or insert bookable meeting times directly into an email
